title: InwardEdgeScan mode params
description: Scans inward from the ROI boundary to detect tip edges using anchor-first N-of-M gradient confirmation with intensity and consistency checks.

roi_expansion_px.description: Expand (positive) or contract (negative) the calibrated ROI outward by this many pixels in every direction before scanning. Positive = search for tips slightly outside expected position. Negative = shave the outer edges of the ROI.

blur_method.description: Blur method applied before gradient computation. 'none' skips blurring; 'gaussian' is a fast general-purpose kernel; 'bilateral' preserves edges.

blur_kernel.description: Gaussian blur kernel size (must be odd). Only used when blur_method = 'gaussian'.

bilateral_d.description: Bilateral filter diameter. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

bilateral_sigma_color.description: Bilateral filter sigma in color space. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

bilateral_sigma_space.description: Bilateral filter sigma in coordinate space. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

use_ab.description: True = use A:B accumulated difference frames; False = single frame.

gradient_ksize.description: Sobel kernel size for the internal edge-gradient computation. Use 3, 5, or 7 (odd values only).

gradient_threshold.description: Minimum gradient magnitude to accept a pixel as an edge candidate.

edge_detection_offset.description: Inward offset (px) from the ROI boundary to start scanning.

confirmation_n.description: Minimum number of edge pixels (N) that must be found in a window of M rows.

confirmation_m.description: Window size (M rows) for N-of-M confirmation.

intensity_delta.description: Minimum intensity step across the edge (inside vs. outside).

intensity_avg_pixels.description: Number of pixels averaged on each side of the edge for intensity comparison.

confirmation_brightness_threshold.description: Absolute brightness threshold used alongside gradient confirmation.

min_edge_length_enabled.description: Discard detected edges shorter than min_edge_length.

min_edge_length.description: Minimum edge length (rows) to retain. Only used when min_edge_length_enabled = true.

consistency_check_enabled.description: Reject edge segments that are spatially inconsistent (large lateral jumps).

consistency_window.description: Row window for measuring lateral consistency.

consistency_sigma.description: Number of standard deviations beyond which a point is considered inconsistent.

outlier_removal_enabled.description: Apply statistical outlier removal to the final edge point set.

section_offset.description: Extra rows of overlap added to each ROI section boundary.

bottom_search_depth.description: Number of rows scanned downward to find the tip bottom.

bottom_scan_half_width.description: Half-width (cols) of the horizontal scan zone for bottom edge detection.

min_confidence.description: Minimum quality score (normalised) to emit a TipCandidate.

max_candidates.description: Maximum number of candidates forwarded to the integrator.

use_contrast.description: When true, a per-pixel difference between the sample frame and a reference frame (e.g. tip without liquid) is computed before all other processing. The reference source is set in the A/B Compare dialog or via ImageSet.reference_frames. The contrast image replaces the normal working frame.

contrast_mode.description:
'absolute' — output = |sample − reference|. Values below contrast_min → 0; at or above contrast_max → 255; in between linearly scaled to 0–255.

'relative' — signed difference centred at grey (127). sample brighter → > 127; reference brighter → < 127. |diff| < contrast_min → 127 (neutral); |diff| ≥ contrast_max → 0 or 255.

contrast_blur_method.description: Blur applied independently to both sample and reference before computing the difference. Independent of any other blur step in the pipeline.

contrast_blur_kernel.description: Gaussian kernel size for the contrast pre-blur (must be odd). Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'gaussian'.

contrast_bilateral_d.description: Bilateral filter diameter for the contrast pre-blur. Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'bilateral'.

contrast_bilateral_sigma_color.description: Bilateral sigma colour for the contrast pre-blur. Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'bilateral'.

contrast_bilateral_sigma_space.description: Bilateral sigma space for the contrast pre-blur. Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'bilateral'.

contrast_min.description: Minimum contrast threshold (0–255). Differences smaller than this are suppressed: 0 in absolute mode, 127 (neutral grey) in relative mode. Filters noise and background flicker.

contrast_max.description: Maximum contrast cap (0–255). Differences at or above this are fully saturated. Values between contrast_min and contrast_max are linearly stretched to 0–255. Must be greater than contrast_min.
